Only two change records exist for frontend in the 24h window, both from platform-automation and both ~8 minutes before onset: a workload/container first-creation and a service config creation, two seconds apart. The pairing and wording of the two entries indicate an initial bootstrap of the frontend workload (first-ever creation of the object), not a redeploy of an existing service or a runtime parameter change. The timing places a cold-start/bootstrap of frontend immediately upstream of onset, making startup-time behaviour (first-run initialization, cold caches, dependency discovery at boot) the leading change-related explanation rather than a behavioural change to running code. The query was scoped to frontend at zero hops, so the record contains no coverage of ad, cart, checkout, product-catalog, or recommendation; their change state is unexamined, not clean.
